name: observable-store
description: Observable key-value state store with per-key change subscriptions, batched transactions, and JSON serialization — a lightweight MobX-style reactive store.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need reactive state management without a full framework. Observers are notified only when the specific key they watch changes. Use transaction() to batch multiple mutations into one notification cycle, preventing intermediate renders or effects.

parameters.name: initialState
parameters.description: Optional initial key-value state to seed the store on construction.
